title: Humana Board Declares Payment of Quarterly Dividend to Stockholders
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Humana Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.

LOUISVILLE, Ky.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apr. 15, 2026-- Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a cash dividend to stockholders of $0.885 per share payable on July 31, 2026 to stockholders of record as of the close of business on June 26, 2026.


**About Humana**


Humana (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at[Humana.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.humana.com%2F&esheet=54513169&newsitemid=20260415863102&lan=en-US&anchor=Humana.com&index=1&md5=55f91ccaaf6779c10c9f7c5c7ad21f5c) and at[CenterWell.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centerwell.com%2F&esheet=54513169&newsitemid=20260415863102&lan=en-US&anchor=CenterWell.com&index=2&md5=b30f36fde01775be9d657cdf1f961691) .
